segments.say: A fourteen-year-old beats his only friend until he *bleeds*, and nobody dares stop him.
Vellop Schmidtz is the kindest boy in the Runcandel *yard*.
He always held back, so the others could win by a narrow *margin*.
Jin saw it all, and today he calls Vellop out in front of *everyone*.
Vellop *trembles*, but he lifts his wooden sword.
Then Jin attacks with no warning, and every blow lands harder than the *last*.
Vellop is thrown across the yard, and the whole class goes *silent*.
Jin just stands over him and asks, do you think this is a sparring *match*?
Vellop cannot answer. He is on the *ground*.
Golden light wraps his wooden sword. It is the glow of *aura*.
He grits his teeth, tears in his eyes, and *charges*.
Jin kicks the sword away and grabs him by the *throat*.
Why would Jin do this to the only boy who *trusts* him?
The full story is on our channel.
